help: Prints in-depth debug data for the Legio siege manager and every active siege (stage, health, capture progress, command CR, fleet counts, etc.).
Force-ends (lifts) all active Legio sieges, dispersing their fleets back home.
Force-launches a new Legio siege now, bypassing the spawn timer. Optionally pass a star system name to pin the target; otherwise one is auto-picked.
